shared_elements: low-relief carving of figural motifs on a flat-ish stone surface
curved/arcing linear elements (wing-like or crescentic forms)
repeated parallel incised lines used to fill a form
justification: A shows a highly specific scene: a standing winged anthropomorphic figure in profile, wearing a horned headdress and fringed garment, with a large feathered wing rendered in rows of parallel strokes, beside a vertical column of stacked rosette/palmette plants. B shows only vague curved and looped relief lines with no legible figure, attribute or arrangement matching A; the only correspondence is the generic use of shallow relief with curving lines, which any tradition could produce.
